maddeler.e:
اقترضن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَضْنَ (iqtaraḍna) /iq.ta.radˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اُقْتُرِضْنَ (uqturiḍna) /uq.tu.ridˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اِقْتَرِضْنَ (iqtariḍna) /iq.ta.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
